description: Madagascar - Settlement Patterns is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics, Energy access", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. This dataset was developed by KTH-dESA and describes settlement patterns relating to electrification in Madagascar. Using the Open Source Spatial Electrification Tool three attributes have been assigned to the settlements retrieved from the Madagascar High Resolution Settlement Layer developed by Facebook Connectivity Lab and CIESIN [1]. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 3 files in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Demographics, Energy access. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
